code_review: Only standard-library imports; utility reads caller-selected target and never launches a process or writes a file.
Nonzero return code rejects before receipt matching; missing/empty/nonfile targets and unusable receipts fail.
One matching record is required across supported complete JSON or JSON-line mixed logs; source/artifact hashes, byte counts and recursively compared options are bound.
Metadata is preserved. Boolean/number aliases in options and byte counts are rejected; JSON-number equality for int/float options is intentional.
Matching is point-in-time validation of trusted export data. The function explicitly disclaims freshness, PDF syntax/content/layout and sandbox or provenance enforcement.

documentation_review.scope: Reviewed supplied readiness Markdown and triage JSON. Task outcome/cost/worker-repair counts are expressly scoped; complete cost is unknown; no milestone promotion, model comparison, caller adoption, public push or sandbox qualification is asserted. All50 milestone identifiers occur exactly once in the grouping. Did not independently repeat the root historical literature/milestone review.
documentation_review.nonblocking_note: G01 alternative explanation says the operating environment explains the failed export. Unless saved diagnostics establish that cause, may explain is the more precise wording. This does not affect utility acceptance.
documentation_review.qualification_status: Triage qualification is still not_run and its evidence references empty at review time; root must populate the observed result before describing P009 as a completed checkpoint.

comparative_boundary: The actual existing parser and its surrounding nonzero-exit guard were used. All8 specified valid cases pass both; the reference rejects19/20 contract negatives and accepts an empty correctly hashed output, while the utility rejects it. This is narrow added coverage, not evidence of general superiority or speed. It is not a claim of equivalence on every possible input the older permissive parser accepted.
publication_safety: Portable probe contains standard-library code and synthetic data only. Sanitized qualification output contains case IDs/hashes/counts/exception classes, not private paths, candidate records or source identities. Raw exception detail is separate private-probe-log.json.
not_claimed: No filesystem boundary or concurrency lock
No comparative performance or complete-cost result
